content_sections.heading: ASBB Job Description
content_sections.text: Project Associate (Agrobiodiversity) Collect information and data on the agrobiodiversity including crop wild relatives of Assam from primary and secondary sources. Preparation of checklist for agrobiodiversity, photographic and video etc. Conduct workshops and meetings with FPGs of Assam for sensitization of conserving indigenous seed diversity of Assam. Collection & compilation of data on research projects/works undertake by institutions/organizations in the field of agrobiodiversity or similar fields. Assist in preparing Biodiversity Compendium of Assam. Data entry in Digital PBR database. Other related works of the Board as and when required. Project Assistant (Wildlife) Collect information and data on the floral and faunal diversity including microbes of Assam from primary and secondary sources. Preparation of checklist for floral and faunal biodiversity including microbes, photographic documentation of Biodiversity of Assam etc. Collection & compilation of data on research projects/works undertake by institutions/organizations in the field of biotechnology /microbiology or similar fields. Assist in preparing Biodiversity Compendium of Assam. Data entry in Digital PBR database. Other related works of the Board as and when required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ASBB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ASBB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Project Associate (Agrobiodiversity), 1 Project Assistant (Wildlife).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ASBB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Attached in the notification PDF) and send it to Assam State Biodiversity Board, Aranya Bhawan, 2nd Floor, Panjabari, Guwahati-781037, by hard copy by post or in person, to reach by 10 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 35 years (as on 1 October 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 32,000 for Project Associate (Agrobiodiversity), Rs. 25,000 for Project Assistant (Wildlife).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.Sc. in Agriculture or Zoology or Wildlife Sciences. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Resident of Assam. Occasional travelling is required within Assam.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications sent through email will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of candidates. Personal Interview. Only shortlisted candidates would be called for Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Duration of engagement is 12 months. Engagement may be extended based on project requirement and fund availability.
